report_meta.title: SIRINX GHOSTCLAW Manager — Architecture & Analysis Report
report_meta.source: SIRINX_GHOSTCLAW_MASTER_v3.0.txt (4497 lines, 18 files, generated 2026-07-21 by Kimi3/KimiSwarm3)
report_meta.analyzed_by: solis (Hermes) — read-only code review, no execution

system_purpose: Multi-agent orchestration (47 Ronin Swarm) + semi-automatic crisis recovery + QA gating + brainstorm auto-approval on Apple Silicon M2

components.sirinx_crisis_recovery.py: KuduHermesBridge: 5-phase recovery (thermal/disk/git/cron/service). Metric sensor + self-healing playbooks.
components.omniroute_swarm_orchestrator.py: OmniRouteSwarmOrchestrator: 7 agents (marut/akkee/wayu/hermes_dev/hermes_qa/kudu_sysops/unlimited_ocr) + 6 KimiSwarm3 patterns + Ollama API loop + auto-deploy.
components.brain_storm_system.py: BrainStormAnalyzer: 6-factor risk analysis, 4 approval tiers (AUTO_APPROVE>90% / CONDITIONAL / HUMAN_REVIEW / REJECT).
components.agent_lens_manager.py: AgentLensManager: 6 lane types, conflict rules, resource locking (threading.Lock), status-lock anti-deletion.
components.telegram_omniroute_controller.py: TelegramOmniRouteController: easy-button bot (NORMAL/DEGRADED/CRISIS keyboards) wired to recovery + orchestrator.
components.github_actions_auto_recovery.yml: 7-job CI/CD: health-check to auto-recovery to qa-gate to swarm-test to deploy to drift-detection to kimi3-validation.
components.prompt_patterns/*: 7 agent system prompts (hermes_dev, hermes_qa, kudu_sysops, omniroute_router, marut, akkee, wayu).

swarm_pipeline: Pre-flight to Marut(schema) to Akkee(api) to Wayu(QA) to Hermes-QA(deep) to [APPROVED]Deploy / [FAIL]Retry(max3)
strengths: Clear 5-phase recovery ordering (thermal to disk to git to cron to service) is a safe sequence.
AgentLensManager uses threading.Lock + resource locks + status-lock anti-deletion for good isolation.
BrainStorm 6-factor + 4-tier approval with human escalation on critical/security/financial is sound governance.
A2A JSON-Schema is well-structured and versioned (kimi3/kimiswarm3 versions).
Dashboard + production.md give the team a single source of truth.
QA veto gate (Hermes-QA) before any deploy is the correct human-in-code pattern.

critical_defects.issue: Auto-deploy runs git add -A and git commit; Wayu emits APPROVE_AND_TRIGGER_GIT_PUSH then Hermes-QA APPROVED triggers _deploy() which commits. No human approval, no dry-run, no branch protection. Violates AGENTS.md A5/A6 and the project no-push-without-approval rule.
critical_defects.impact: Unattended code could be committed/pushed to migration/v5-rebase automatically.
critical_defects.fix: Gate _deploy behind explicit human confirmation; default to dry-run; never auto-commit on main tree.

critical_defects.issue: On submodule failure it runs git rm -f integrations/cynative then git commit -m non-interactively. Mutates working tree and commits without review.
critical_defects.impact: Silent destructive mutation of repo history.
critical_defects.fix: Never auto-commit; only stash; report submodule error for human.

critical_defects.issue: Uses bare shutil.rmtree(target/) and os.remove walks in ~/.hermes / ~/.codex with try/except but no allowlist/dry-run guard. Could delete recent sessions/cache. Same destructive pattern your background codex audit was meant to harden.
critical_defects.impact: Potential loss of recent Codex/Hermes sessions if paths drift.

critical_defects.issue: get_live_metrics hardcodes fallback disk 228/191/11/95 and PIDs 2620/2630/2705; disk_recovery frees estimated space (space_freed += 3.3 for npm without verifying). Metrics are synthetic, not measured.
critical_defects.impact: Recovery report can claim success while disk stays 95%.
critical_defects.fix: Compute real freed bytes from before/after du; remove hardcoded guesses.

critical_defects.issue: Calls Ollama models (deepseek-coder-v2:16b, llama3:70b-q4, qwen2.5:32b, glm-edge-code:uncensored, baidu/Unlimited-OCR) not verified present on this 8GB M2. 70B model cannot load on 8GB. No model-availability check. Declares 47 Ronin but only 7 agents defined.
critical_defects.impact: Swarm loop fails at first agent call; roster mismatch.
critical_defects.fix: Pre-flight model check; right-size models to M2 (8B/14B max); reconcile 47 vs 7.

critical_defects.issue: deploy job runs wrangler deploy + supabase db push + git push --tags automatically on success — cloud mutation + push without human gate. Runs on macos-latest, not the M2.
critical_defects.fix: Add environment protection / required reviewer; gate auto-push behind manual approval.

critical_defects.issue: Schema references 9 AgentRoles incl strategic_advisor but orchestrator defines 7; brainstorm consensus hardcodes only 4 agents. Inconsistent agent registry.
critical_defects.fix: Single source-of-truth agent registry shared by schema + orchestrator + brainstorm.

critical_defects.issue: handoff() uses state['handoff_at': None] = ... — invalid dict literal. Would SyntaxError if handoff invoked. (The main-file copy uses __main__ correctly; this is in the recovered snippet.)

good: Command blocklist in kudu_sysops prompt (no rm -rf /, no chmod 777, no sudo)
Never git reset --hard (uses stash) — aligns with your root-cause bug
gaps: No actual allowlist enforcement in Python (only documented in prompts)
Secrets (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, POSTGRES_PASSWORD=sirinx2026) in plaintext in docker-compose/env appendices
auto-deploy bypasses the documented human gate

recommendation: ARCHITECTURE APPROVED FOR REVIEW. Do NOT run on this Mac mini in current form: D1/D2 (auto-commit/deploy) and D3 (unguarded rmtree) violate project safety law. Recommend: (1) add dry-run+allowlist to recovery, (2) gate _deploy behind human approval, (3) verify models fit 8GB M2, (4) reconcile agent registry. Then pilot in staging.
